title: Global CTX Mosaic of Mars (V01)
description:
Beta Notice: This item is currently in beta and is intended for early access, testing, and feedback. It is not recommended for production use, as functionality and content are subject to change without notice.
 
The Bruce Murray Laboratory for Planetary Visualization produced this 5.7 terapixel mosaic of the surface of Mars rendered at 5.0 m/px. Each pixel in the mosaic is about the size of a typical parking space, providing unprecedented resolution of the Martian surface at a global scale. The mosaic consists of 86,571 separate images which have been aligned (semi-controlled) and blended with one another.
 
The mosaic covers 99.5% of Mars from 88°S to 88°N. The pixels that make up the mosaic can all be mapped back to their source data using the seam maps provided at the main project site, where an uncompressed version of the mosaic can also be found.
 
All data in the mosaic come from the Context Camera (CTX) onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO).
